teaser.title: Off the Record
lines: An anonymous retro, live from your phone.
No ~~action items~~ follow-ups. Just a look back, together.

notes.text: The new build pipeline cut our wait from twenty minutes to five.
I wasn't sure my idea was worth raising, so I kept it to myself.
Our weekly check-in finally stopped feeling like a status report.

theme.name: Small wins at work
theme.haiku: Pipelines run so fast / the coffee is still too hot / we smile at the clock
